response.sql: WITH site_ratio AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(m.facetresmm * 1.0 / m.geomdeltamm) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count FROM scanmesh m JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_avg AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio FROM site_ratio GROUP BY insurstat) SELECT r.insurstat, AVG(r.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio_above_avg_sites, COUNT(*) AS site_count, AVG(r.avg_ratio - a.status_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess FROM site_ratio r JOIN status_avg a ON a.insurstat = r.insurstat WHERE r.avg_ratio > a.status_avg_ratio GROUP BY r.insurstat

assumptions.assumption: A site's mesh count is the number of all its matched scanmesh records, including those whose ratio is missing (null facetresmm/geomdeltamm or zero geomdeltamm, which SQLite divides to NULL); only the ratio average ignores missing values.
Sites with no recorded insurance status means insurstat IS NULL; sites with no valid ratio at all have a NULL average and are ignored in the status average and never count as above average.

alternatives.interpretation: Mesh count only counts mesh records that have a computable (non-null) ratio.
